title: Black Sesame Salad Dressing
summary: A creamy, tangy sesame dressing combining toasted black and white sesame seeds, peanut butter, and unsweetened soy milk.

steps.description: Grind 3 tbsp toasted black sesame seeds and 1 tbsp toasted white sesame seeds in a mortar or small blender until fine. Grinding releases their nutty aroma.
In a bowl, mix the ground sesame seeds with 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 1/2 tbsp unsweetened peanut butter, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 2 tsp sugar, and a pinch of salt until evenly combined.
Pour in 40 ml unsweetened soy milk and whisk until smooth. For a thinner dressing, gradually add more soy milk, up to 60 ml total. Serve with your salad.
